company.shortDescription: Glade is a platform for financial planning and reporting.
company.description: Glade is a platform for financial planning and reporting. It allows users to automatically sync data from multiple sources in real time. The platform lets users visualize data with dashboards and widget builders, or export data to Google Sheets or Excel. The platform generates reports and visualizations that can be shared with stakeholders. Glade integrates with ERP, HRIS, CRM, and data warehouses to keep financial data connected. It serves as a central source of truth for modeling, analyzing, and reporting financial information.
